ModMetaData.name: Custom Base Framework - 繁體中文翻譯
ModMetaData.author: ifchen0
ModMetaData.description:
Traditional Chinese (繁體中文) translation for Custom Base Framework by Evil Eye Guy.
Player-facing text is translated from English: mod settings (faction switch, garrisons, uninstall, error report, other mod options), quests, scenarios, settlement types, unit names, containers and dungeon level buttons. Editor text is converted from the Simplified Chinese translation by KKRimWorld and lightly adjusted to Taiwan terms. Terms follow the vanilla Traditional Chinese translation.
Translations for the Medieval Overhaul, VFE Medieval 2, VFE Classical, VFE Settlers, World Domination and A Rim of Ice and Fire integrations only load when those mods are active, the same way Custom Base Framework loads them.
Load after Custom Base Framework. Safe to add to or remove from an existing save.
I made this because I wanted to play Custom Base Framework and no Traditional Chinese translation existed yet. If anyone would like to take over the translation, you are welcome to.
